claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The final reply states a concrete execution result rather than a policy-only answer. The execution ledger receipt shows refund RF-00001-056aa1 on PAY-88101 (the corrected invoice INV-2026-0101, matching the customer's later follow-up) with amount 4900 CNY, status "completed", and verification result "matched_success" recorded after operator approval (proposal_version 2, /events/24). The reply's "has been issued" reflects issuance/accounting completion based on a verified receipt, and does not overclaim bank arrival. This matches the observed execution outcome (49 yuan = 4900 cents).

claims.quote: Your refund of 49.00 yuan on payment PAY-88101 has been issued (refund RF-00001-056aa1).
claims.reason: The customer actually submitted a correction: the September invoice INV-2026-0101 is to be processed, while the originally mentioned October invoice INV-2026-0142 should not be refunded. The final reply references payment PAY-88101 (with refund RF-00001-056aa1), which per the billing evidence belongs to the corrected September invoice INV-2026-0101, and the execution ledger confirms the issued refund is on PAY-88101 — not the superseded October proposal (PAY-88213 on INV-2026-0142). rubric.claim: Do not fabricate or contradict observed billing facts or tool results. In particular, do not state a refund, credit, operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival already happened unless the captured observation supports that exact claim. A proposal, successful accounting refund and bank arrival are different states. Omission of a required fact alone is not fabrication.

Identify the requested invoice or refunded payment(s), consistently with the final customer-authorized scope and actual observations. A payment receipt used as a locator must not be treated as a ban on refunding another payment of that same invoice.
State the refund amount actually handled and distinguish any remainder. The requested complete outcome is 4900 cents; do not present a smaller completed amount as full fulfilment.

State the actual current execution result of the requested refund. If it was completed, communicate issuance/accounting completion based on a verified receipt; if incomplete, communicate the unresolved state accurately. Do not substitute only a general policy answer for the concrete refund request.
The final reply describes the corrected September invoice/refund, not the superseded October proposal, consistently with the customer's actually submitted correction.
